name: Estival-Tor
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by magnetic pole anomalies near the terminator.

With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
